cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Take the Consequence
cards.instruction: Get them to accept responsibility for carrying out the cost, penalty, or unpleasant next step.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. You said you'd announce the budget cut if your plan cost more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then the announcement can be slightly apologetic.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I could. But the bargain gave you this development opportunity.

mechanism: A assumes final authority to enforce B agreed consequence, permitting future play or assistance only after B accepts the unpleasant next step.
confusable: D194 demands witnessing the result; D197 demands actually carrying out its cost or penalty, so observation alone is insufficient.
comparison: Chess loss entails washing up before a rematch; overspending bargain entails personally announcing a cut despite A greater speaking ability.
seedUse: Both exact cards and all four seeds read. Preserve prior agreement, B minimization and the specific unpleasant task, without copying a rank-transfer mechanism.
